h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Naihati

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Naihati

items.pText: Naihati is an old jute mill town on the east bank of the Hooghly, north of Kolkata. The air is humid for most of the year, the monsoon is long, and ground that stays damp in shade soon grows moss and algae. For a school, a club or a housing society here, the surface under and around the play equipment needs as much thought as the equipment.

Every piece of equipment we send to Naihati is built at our Vasai factory, about 1,650 km away. We send it to West Bengal by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it. We also supply rubber flooring for play areas. Tell us the size of your site, how much sun it gets and the age group of the children, and our layout drawing will show the safe play area around each piece.

richText.heading: Keeping play surfaces from turning slippery

c: Bare concrete and old tiles in a shaded corner become slippery once the rains start. Rubber flooring drains better and gives a softer landing, but it still needs a slight slope and an outlet so water does not sit on it. Sweep it regularly and scrub any green patches before they spread.
Steps, decks and slide exits pick up the same film in deep shade. If you can, place the play area where it gets some morning sun. A

items.q: What flooring works best in Naihati's humid climate?
items.a: Rubber flooring laid with a slight slope and proper drainage is a good choice. It cushions falls and dries faster than packed earth. We can supply it along with the equipment.

items.q: How do we stop moss growing on the play area?
items.a: Pick a spot with some sun, keep water from standing and scrub green patches early. Roto-moulded decks and slides can be washed down with water and a soft brush.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in towns near Naihati?
items.a: Yes. We supply towns along the Hooghly such as Chinsurah, Bhatpara and Barasat in the same way, with dispatch by road from Vasai and installation by our team or a dealer.
